title: TNR Potency Skill Tree
status: approved progression and core taxonomy; Hidden Arts roster and Advanced Arts candidates await review
historical_filename_note: Mandala/V1 filenames and existing advanced/pinnacle ID namespaces are stable references only; no radial topology remains.

engine_mapping_notes.multi_tag_selector: affectedTags is a design union, not a runtime field. Future authoring expands to one singular affectedTag modifier per distinct tag. A purchase must match each effect at most once.
engine_mapping_notes.element_selector: Within a modifier, element and specific tag are AND; multiple selected elements are OR. Across purchased modifiers, percentages add. Current element matching reads the individual effect tag, not a jutsu-wide label.
engine_mapping_notes.duration: Legacy rounds:100 is an authoring candidate within schema bounds, not verified permanent passive behaviour. Combat attachment/lifetime needs implementation review.
engine_mapping_notes.sub_budget: Router currently checks global user.skillPoints; no Potency-specific 30-SP cap is enforced.
engine_mapping_notes.stacking: BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at source pin; preserve two purchase contributions and prevent duplicate expansion.
engine_mapping_notes.none: None is the non-elemental sentinel, not a Special Element school.

implementation_gaps.summary: Add Absorb to upstream PotencyTagTypes and dependent labels/support handling before Assimilation and other Absorb scopes can function.
Reconcile intended jutsu-element scope with per-tag matching. Heal and Increase Heal lack elements and are treated as None; elemental healing scopes currently cannot match schema-valid tags.
Enforce the 30-SP Potency allocation; current global budget permits more points.

deferred_schools.name: Balanced Form
deferred_schools.reason: Old three-Minor generalist route was not reaffirmed; do not silently classify it as a Major-gated Advanced Art.

deferred_schools.name: Harmony
deferred_schools.reason: Needs distinct exact scope and affordable Major prerequisites. Three Foundation Majors consume all 30 SP before any Harmony purchase. Any-two-of-five prerequisites also need OR handling beyond current requiredSkillIds AND.

deferred_schools.name: Unbroken Form
deferred_schools.reason: Avoid a second Guard school with an identical selector and no distinct purpose. Exact scope and Major gate require review.
